Extract a named feature hierarchy from images

Source: R/hierarchy_extract.R
extract_feature_hierarchy.Rd

Runs one batched multi-output forward pass and applies a per-stage pooler. Convolutional activations are converted to NHWC before pooling. The virtual tap classifier_logits is computed from fc2 and the ImageNet classifier weights without applying softmax.

Usage

extract_feature_hierarchy(
  impaths,
  spec,
  model = NULL,
  batch_size = 16L,
  layout = c("nhwc", "nchw")
)

Arguments

impaths

Character vector of image paths, or a directory containing jpg/jpeg/png files.

spec

A vgg_hierarchy_spec or other feature_hierarchy_spec.

model

Optional preloaded Keras model. If NULL, the spec architecture is loaded with ImageNet weights.

batch_size

Images per forward pass.

layout

Layout of 4-D backend outputs; "nhwc" for Keras.

Value

A as_feature_hierarchy object. Its schema records the taps, the poolers, and the layout that produced the blocks.

Details

Spatial pooling is set per stage in spec; see poolers for the options. Each block has one row per image and one column per pooled feature, named as described in pooler_feature_names. Full-resolution maps are pooled batch by batch and never held for all images at once, so memory use depends on batch_size and on the pooled width, not on the number of images.

See also

vgg_hierarchy_spec, poolers, and vignette("spatial-pooling", package = "imfeatures").

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
imgs <- list.files("stimuli", pattern = "\\.jpg$", full.names = TRUE)

# Depth-adaptive DCT pooling at the end of each VGG-16 block
raw <- extract_feature_hierarchy(imgs, spec = vgg16_block_end_spec())
vapply(raw$blocks, ncol, integer(1))

# The same taps, with a 3 x 3 grid on every convolutional stage
taps <- vgg_block_end_taps("vgg16")
pooling <- lapply(taps, function(tap) adaptive_grid_pool(3, 3))
pooling[c("fc1", "logits")] <- list(identity_pool(), identity_pool())
spec <- vgg_hierarchy_spec("vgg16", taps = taps, pooling = pooling)
raw_grid <- extract_feature_hierarchy(imgs, spec = spec)
} # }
